text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: My "Romance" is building a huge castle where I can sing, raise hell, and have a blast with my precious crew!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
"We won't be boxed in by 'common sense'!
We'll keep living freely and joyfully, right down to the tip of our tails!"

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: "I want the money necessary for that! And the fame needed to get that money, too!"

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
Is that your... mission?
To make it a reality... at the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, number one in the world is a title that fits me perfectly!
My crew is on cloud nine, too!

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: Then first, I gotta snag one of the four spots representing Japan.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: ...Sirius.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Oho, there you are. The romantic posing
as a Symboli realist.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: Tch...

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Haha, don't make that face.
I love both of you so much,
Sirius and Speed Symboli!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
...Oops, my phone's ringing.
Excuse me.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: ...Sirius. Why did you—spur her on?

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
...You can tell just by looking. She's probably a late bloomer,
but Tap's growth has really hit a plateau.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
She has the strength to talk about her ideals,
but that alone won't make her dreams come true.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Knowing the reality, what will she do next?
That's something she has to decide for herself.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah. Keep your eyes on me, everyone.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
I'll definitely bring you the title of world's best.
Fame, fortune—we'll have it all!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: —Let's have a match!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The very first words out of Tap Dance City's mouth upon her sudden arrival were bold and brazen.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Let's see who's stronger, you guys or me!
We'll settle it at the Representative Exchange Race!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: Yeah. From what I looked into, it seems you guys are considered the top contenders to represent Japan.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
"That's why I came here looking for a comeback!
Take me on in this match!"

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: "I have to be the captain of the ship chasing after the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe."
